card.name: Single-dose packaging phrases
card.fires_on: Words just before or inside 'single-dose' or 'single-use' wording in how-supplied text, such as 'supplied in' or the '-use' and 'ose' of single-use and single-dose. Also the digit in product strengths like 100/33.

modes.label: Supplied in single-dose
modes.description: The word 'in' after 'is supplied' when a single-dose container follows.
modes.example: OXLUMO is a sterile, preservative-free, clear, colorless-to-yellow solution. It is supplied<< in>> a single-dose vial

modes.label: Inside single-use/dose
modes.description: The ending of 'single-use' or 'single-dose' describing vials, pens or packets.
modes.example: Imiquimod Cream is packaged in single<<-use>> packets which contain sufficient cream to cover a

modes.label: Strength digits
modes.description: A digit in a product strength just before an injection instruction.
modes.example: 100/33 if the solution is clear and colorless to almost colorless. Inject SOLIQUA 100/<<3>>3 subcutaneously into the abdominal area
